title: Rey alone!
description: At the Battle of Takodana, Rey encountered Kylo Ren in the surrounding woods, then fired at him with her blaster pistol. With hardly any effort at all, Ren restrained his attacker by calling upon the Force. Probing the young woman's mind, he discovered that Rey had actually seen the map he and his opposite numbers in the Resistance were searching for. Ren then commanded the First Order to pull out of the current battle, proclaiming that they had what they came for, and no longer needed to find BB-8.
section: Star Wars: The Force Awakens #13 of 20
